description: osirAppDeploy: Deploy an app to Osir (free tier) and get a live HTTPS URL; the app runs isolated in a microVM. Deploying an existing app name redeploys it (new version) and applies any secrets set via osirAppSetSecret. A plain static website (HTML/CSS/JS with no framework or build step) is also supported: it is auto-detected and served directly; pass language 'node' for it. To put the app on the user's OWN VPS, server or production box instead, deploy it here first and then call osirAppDeployToVps - never SSH into the box or write an install script. Once an app is on the user's own VPS, redeploying HERE under the same name is how you update it: the platform re-ships it to the box and keeps its domain. Requires authentication.

language.description: Runtime language: 'node', 'python', 'php-laravel', or 'go'; use 'node' for a plain static site.

name.description: App name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. 'habit-tracker'.

region.description: Region: 'us' or 'al' ('al' is Albania/Tirana); defaults to the platform's home region.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

uploadTicket.description: Upload ticket from osirAppCreateUpload, after uploading the zipped source to its putUrl.

name: osirAppDeploy
